issues.description: Logic incorrectly excludes valid triples by checking and skipping rows r2 that contain 'o' in both columns, causing undercounting.

Algorithmic complexity is too high (nested pair loops and per-pair scans). Will TLE for N up to 2000. Use per-column counts and the formula contrib_row = (k_r - 1) * sum_{c in row r} (col_count[c] - 1) for O(M) runtime.
No tests or examples provided with the implementation; add unit tests or sample-run checks (use provided sample inputs).
Both row->cols and col->rows are built; with the corrected formula only row->cols and a column counts array are needed. Current structures lead to unnecessary complexity.
